annotation.evidence_span: Other versions of TLS MUST provide a similar function in order to be used QUIC.
annotation.interpretation_a: The "similar function" refers to the exact HKDF-Expand-Label function defined in TLS 1.3, with the same hash function and label semantics.
annotation.interpretation_b: The "similar function" allows any HKDF‑based key derivation function that produces a key, without requiring the same parameters or label format as TLS 1.3.
annotation.justification: The clause uses the undefined term "similar function" without specifying the exact function or its parameters, permitting materially different implementation behaviours.
